nl: List all open purchase orders
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS

nl: Show all plants
sql: SELECT * FROM CORE_PLANT

nl: Count of open purchase orders
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS

nl: Total open value in USD across all purchase orders
sql: SELECT SUM(OPEN_VALUE_IN_USD) AS total_open_value_usd FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS

nl: Average open value in USD per purchase order
sql: SELECT AVG(OPEN_VALUE_IN_USD) AS avg_open_value_usd FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS

nl: Top 5 purchase orders by open value in USD
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS ORDER BY OPEN_VALUE_IN_USD DESC LIMIT 5

nl: Show purchase orders for vendor Honeywell Aerospace
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS WHERE VEND_NM = 'Honeywell Aerospace'

nl: List purchase orders where supplier type is External
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS WHERE SUPPLIER_TYPE = 'External'

nl: Count of purchase orders by vendor
sql: SELECT VEND_NM, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS GROUP BY VEND_NM

nl: Total open value by plant
sql: SELECT PLANT_ID, SUM(OPEN_VALUE_IN_USD) AS total_open_value FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS GROUP BY PLANT_ID

nl: Show plants in the US
sql: SELECT * FROM CORE_PLANT WHERE COUNTRY = 'US'

nl: List all plant names and cities
sql: SELECT PLANT_NAME, CITY FROM CORE_PLANT

nl: Count of plants by country
sql: SELECT COUNTRY, COUNT(*) AS plant_count FROM CORE_PLANT GROUP BY COUNTRY

nl: Show purchase orders with open quantity greater than 100
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS WHERE OPEN_QTY > 100

nl: List purchase orders with delivery date in 2026
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS WHERE PO_SCHD_LINE_DELIVERY_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND PO_SCHD_LINE_DELIVERY_DATE < '2027-01-01'

nl: Total open value by material group
sql: SELECT MATERIAL_GROUP_DESCRIPTION, SUM(OPEN_VALUE_IN_USD) AS total_value FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS GROUP BY MATERIAL_GROUP_DESCRIPTION

nl: Top 10 vendors by total open value
sql: SELECT VEND_NM, SUM(OPEN_VALUE_IN_USD) AS total_value FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS GROUP BY VEND_NM ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10

nl: Show inventory snapshots for plant P100
sql: SELECT * FROM EDW_INVENTORY_SEGMENTATION_SNAPSHOT WHERE PLANT_ID = 'P100'

nl: Count of materials by segment
sql: SELECT SEGMENT, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM EDW_INVENTORY_SEGMENTATION_SNAPSHOT GROUP BY SEGMENT

nl: Average on-hand quantity by plant
sql: SELECT PLANT_ID, AVG(ON_HAND_QTY) AS avg_on_hand FROM EDW_INVENTORY_SEGMENTATION_SNAPSHOT GROUP BY PLANT_ID

nl: Show materials with excess quantity greater than 50
sql: SELECT * FROM EDW_INVENTORY_SEGMENTATION_SNAPSHOT WHERE EXCESS_QTY > 50

nl: Total on-hand value in USD by lifecycle
sql: SELECT LIFE_CYCLE, SUM(ON_HAND_VALUE_USD) AS total_value FROM EDW_INVENTORY_SEGMENTATION_SNAPSHOT GROUP BY LIFE_CYCLE

nl: Show purchase orders with exception message Expedite
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS WHERE EXCPTN_MSG_DESC = 'Expedite'

nl: List purchase orders for PO type Standard PO
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS WHERE PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE_DESCRIPTION = 'Standard PO'

nl: Total demand quantity by plant
sql: SELECT PLANT_ID, SUM(TOT_DMND_QTY) AS total_demand FROM EDW_MATL_LOC_DEMAND_INFO GROUP BY PLANT_ID

nl: Show purchase orders joined with plant information
sql: SELECT po.*, p.PLANT_NAME, p.CITY, p.COUNTRY FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS po JOIN CORE_PLANT p ON po.PLANT_ID = p.PLANT_ID

nl: Top 3 plants by total open purchase order value
sql: SELECT p.PLANT_NAME, SUM(po.OPEN_VALUE_IN_USD) AS total_value FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS po JOIN CORE_PLANT p ON po.PLANT_ID = p.PLANT_ID GROUP BY p.PLANT_NAME ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 3

nl: Count of purchase orders by purchasing group
sql: SELECT PURCHASING_GROUP_NAME, COUNT(*) AS po_count FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS GROUP BY PURCHASING_GROUP_NAME

nl: Show materials with lifecycle Active
sql: SELECT * FROM EDW_INVENTORY_SEGMENTATION_SNAPSHOT WHERE LIFE_CYCLE = 'Active'

nl: Average lead time by plant
sql: SELECT PLANT_ID, AVG(LEAD_TIME_DAYS) AS avg_lead_time FROM EDW_INVENTORY_SEGMENTATION_SNAPSHOT GROUP BY PLANT_ID

nl: Show purchase orders sorted by open value descending
sql: SELECT * FROM AIML_OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDERS ORDER BY OPEN_VALUE_IN_USD DESC
